note: Coverage of the registries that are coded for the conditions this site describes, outside France. The French registries are drawn département by département in registry-zones.json from the Santé publique France surveillance report. Registries with status "clinical" are not population-based: they recruit through participating hospitals rather than covering a territory, so their outline marks the country they work in and claims no coverage of the births in it. Status "hospital" marks a national system that samples births through reporting hospitals rather than covering every birth in a territory. Entries with "map": false are registries this register lists without drawing: an umbrella with no territory of its own, a hospital network, a single centre, or a national register we cite without having mapped its coverage.
